references.text: Also describes the sending of angels to gather the chosen, which is similar to the gathering of what causes sin and those who do wrong in Matthew 13:41.
Speaks of the Lord's day when the wicked will be removed, parallel to the removal of all that causes sin and those who do wrong in Matthew 13:41.
The prophecy that the wicked will be trampled down, similar to the removal of the wicked in Matthew 13:41.
Refers to a harvest and gathering that can be seen as parallel to the gathering and removal of what is evil in Matthew 13:41.
